import LongTails.Template
import outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution
import outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory OracleTemplate
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal NNReal

namespace outputs.Proofs.FreyaIterations

open outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence
open outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness
open outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning

theorem iteration_accuracy (q : Raw) (hm : 0 < q.m) (hn : 0 < q.n)
    (hS : 0 < q.S) (hK : 0 < q.K) (hρ : 0 < q.ρ) (hρone : q.ρ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < q.η)
    (f : Fin q.m → Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ Lminus) (hD : 0 ≤ Lpm)
    (hreg : RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ)
    (htune : q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * q.S))))
    (τ : Fin q.n → ℝ≥0∞)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request q.d q.m q.n)) (Reply q.d q.n) 1)
    (hservice : PrimitiveService f τ O) (hind : batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : eventLimit q ≤ N) :
    let P := (executionLaw q O : Measure (Seed q.K × ((a : ℕ) → O.Seed a)))
    let accuracy := fun z : Seed q.K × ((a : ℕ) → O.Seed a) =>
      ‖gradient (objective f) (execute O (factory q) (fun _ => N) z.1 z.2).1‖ ^ 2
    Integrable accuracy P ∧
      (∫ z, accuracy z ∂P) ≤ 2 * (objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * q.K) ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 2 * (objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ε) ≤ q.K →
        (∫ z, accuracy z ∂P) ≤ ε := by sorry

theorem family_tuning_legal (p : Family) (hS : 0 < p.S)
    (hρ : 0 < p.ρ) (hρone : p.ρ ≤ 1) (hL : 0 ≤ p.Lminus) (hD : 0 ≤ p.Lpm)
    (hΔ : 0 ≤ p.Δ) (hε : 0 < p.ε)
    (hA : 0 < familyCoefficient p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ) :
    0 < familyStep p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ ∧
      1 ≤ familyHorizon p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ ∧
      2 * p.Δ / (familyStep p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ *
        familyHorizon p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

theorem iterations_execution_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.spec.admissible p f O) :
    outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.spec.successful p f
      (fun z : (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.iterations (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.publicInput p)).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.iterations (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.publicInput p)) (fun _ => p.n * p.m + (p.n * p.m + p.S) * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * p.S))) / p.ε⌉₊ + 1)) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.iterations (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.publicInput p)).law : Measure (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.iterations (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.publicInput p)).Seed).prod
        (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k)), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem iterations_cost (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.spec.valid p) :
    eventLimit (familyRaw (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageIterations.publicInput p) false) ≤ p.n * p.m + (p.n * p.m + p.S) * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * p.S))) / p.ε⌉₊ + 1) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.FreyaIterations
